recommended_next_steps: Use Leonteq public pages as term-sheet discovery and schema examples.
Collect only permitted documents and retain URL, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256 hash.
Ask Leonteq for authorized API/export access to LYNQS or product data.
Do not scrape at scale or bypass access controls.
Keep Leonteq terms, live quotes and realized outcomes in separate evidence classes.
Join underlier histories only with as-of timestamps and no-lookahead controls.
